# Tokio initializes ScheduledIo before registering its address as a mio token
# with the kernel reactor. An event can then be dispatched on another runtime
# worker, but TSan does not model epoll registration and delivery as a
# happens-before edge. It consequently reports the constructor write racing
# with set_readiness even though the kernel cannot return the token before
# registration. Keep this suppression on Tokio's registration allocation path
# so unrelated reactor and transfer-manager races remain visible.
race:tokio::runtime::io::registration_set::RegistrationSet>::allocate
